about.title: About
about.acknowledgmentDescription: TruchiEmu is built entirely on the shoulders of giants. The emulation cores, game databases, artwork, and achievement systems are all the result of thousands of hours of volunteer work by the retro gaming community. This app would not be possible without their generosity.
about.additionalCoresNote: Additional cores (mGBA, Genesis Plus GX, DOSBox Pure, ScummVM, MAME variants, etc.) are available from the libretro buildbot and each carries its own license. Visit the individual repositories on GitHub for details.

shader.desc.builtin-crt-lottes: Advanced CRT simulation by Timothy Lottes. Featuring high-quality scanlines and mask.
shader.desc.builtin-crt-classic: Classic CRT scanlines with barrel distortion and vignette.
shader.desc.builtin-sharp-bilinear: Crisp scaling that avoids shimmering. Ideal for modern displays.
shader.desc.builtin-8b-gameboy: High-fidelity Game Boy simulation with customizable bezel and dynamic lighting.
shader.desc.builtin-8b-gameboy-color: Game Boy Color with temporal feedback, ghosting, and iridescent LCD effects.
shader.desc.builtin-gba: Advanced GBA LCD simulation with ghosting, grid, and metallic reflections.
shader.desc.builtin-psp: PSP LCD simulation with warm color gamut, ghosting, and subtle pixel grid.
shader.desc.builtin-nds: NDS LCD simulation with washed-out color gamut, light ghosting, and visible pixel grid.
shader.desc.builtin-3ds: 3DS LCD simulation with accurate color, no ghosting, and subtle pixel grid.
shader.desc.builtin-dot-matrix: High-quality metallic dot-matrix LCD for Game Boy systems.
shader.desc.builtin-lite-crt: Lightweight CRT effect with simple scanlines and phosphors.
shader.desc.builtin-crt-multipass: Professional CRT simulation with temporal phosphor persistence and high-quality masking.
shader.desc.builtin-smooth-upscale: High-quality pixel art upscaler that smooths edges while maintaining detail.
